text:
[name]
[email] | [phone] | [url]
Wichita, KS

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Operations coordinator with four years of experience in distribution and logistics. Responsible for scheduling, inventory support, vendor communication and reporting. Dependable team player with strong attention to detail.

EXPERIENCE

Tri-State Regional Distribution, Wichita, KS
Operations Coordinator · July 2022 – Present
• Responsible for scheduling inbound and outbound deliveries for the regional warehouse
• Assisted with weekly and monthly inventory counts and reported discrepancies to the operations manager
• Communicated with carriers and vendors regarding delivery windows and delays
• Maintained the shipping log and updated the warehouse management system as needed
• Prepared daily shipping reports for the operations manager
• Coordinated with the sales team on rush orders and special handling requests
• Assisted with onboarding new warehouse associates and walking them through procedures
• Responsible for ordering packaging supplies and keeping the supply area organized
• Served as backup for the receiving clerk during absences
• Participated in safety meetings and helped keep safety documentation up to date
• Responded to customer service inquiries regarding shipment status
• Supported the operations manager with ad hoc projects and data entry
• Maintained the vendor contact list and updated it when carriers changed representatives
• Assisted the safety coordinator with monthly walk-throughs and recorded observations
• Prepared purchase requisitions for approval by the operations manager
• Filed bills of lading and delivery confirmations according to the retention schedule
• Covered the front desk and answered incoming calls during the receptionist's lunch hour
• Helped coordinate the annual physical inventory with the accounting team

Tri-State Regional Distribution, Wichita, KS
Warehouse Associate (seasonal) · Summers 2019, 2020 and 2021
• Picked and packed orders according to pick lists
• Loaded and unloaded trucks
• Assisted with cycle counts and labeling
• Followed safety procedures and reported hazards to the shift lead

Kansas State University Dining Services, Manhattan, KS
Student Supervisor · August 2020 – May 2022
• Supervised student employees during lunch and dinner shifts
• Responsible for opening and closing procedures
• Handled customer questions and resolved issues
• Assisted with scheduling and shift coverage
• Trained new student employees on food safety procedures

EDUCATION

Kansas State University, Manhattan, KS
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, Management · May 2022
Relevant coursework: Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Statistics, Organizational Behavior

SKILLS
• Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
• Warehouse management systems
• Scheduling and calendar management
• Vendor communication
• Inventory support
• Report preparation
• Team collaboration
• Attention to detail

CERTIFICATIONS
• OSHA 10-Hour General Industry, 2023
• Forklift operator certification (employer-provided), 2022

ACTIVITIES
• Volunteer, Kansas Food Bank, monthly, 2023 – Present
• Member, Wichita Young Professionals, 2024 – Present
